product_overview: Event Management Module for SGT University handles event creation via a noting/approval workflow, event discovery, individual & team registrations (free/paid), attendance scanning via QR, certificate generation/distribution, bulk email, stall management and analytics for organizers.
core_goals: Provide a secure, role-based event lifecycle from noting/approval to post-event analytics.
Enable students to discover, register (individual or team), pay (Razorpay), and view tickets/certificates.
Allow event organisers to manage registrations, volunteers, stalls, send bulk emails and distribute verifiable certificates.
Support reliable attendance tracking with QR scanning and robust payment processing including webhook verification.
Ensure scalability for certificate generation and bulk operations with clear audit logs and verification endpoints.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: JWT-based login and role-based access control for Student, Faculty, Staff, Admin, Volunteer and Club Chairperson roles.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and user profile (id, role, name, email) -> GET /api/events with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with Event[] allowed for the user's visibility
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/auth/logout without token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Event Discovery & Listing
features.description: Browse, search and filter published events; festival grouping and pagination for public event discovery.
user_flows: GET /api/events (no auth) with query ?search=workshop&type=seminar&page=1 -> Receive 200 with Event[] matching filters and pagination metadata
GET /api/events (no auth) with query that yields no matches -> Receive 200 with empty Event[] and total=0 indicating empty state

features.name: Event Detail
features.description: View full event details including schedule, capacity, prizes, registration status and CTA to register.
user_flows: GET /api/events/:id (no auth) -> Receive 200 with Event detail (description, dates, venue, registration settings, prizes, visibility)
GET /api/events/:id for an unpublished/restricted event as a student -> Receive 404 Not found (visibility enforced) -> GET /api/events/:id with Admin token -> Receive 200 with Event detail

features.name: Individual Event Registration
features.description: Students register for events (dynamic custom fields supported), apply coupons and handle free or paid registration flows.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/events/:id/register with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { customFields, couponCode? } on free event -> Receive 201 with { registration: Registration, qrCode: string } -> GET /api/users/me/registrations with token -> Receive 200 with Registration[] including new registration
POST /api/events/:id/register with Authorization: Bearer <token> when already registered -> Receive 400 with error 'already registered' or validation error

features.name: Team Registration
features.description: Create and manage teams for team-based events, invite/join members, finalize teams and create registrations for all members.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid student credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/events/:id/teams with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { teamName } -> Receive 201 with Team -> POST /api/events/:id/teams/:teamId/join with Authorization: Bearer <token> by invited member -> Receive 200 with Team -> POST /api/events/:id/teams/:teamId/finalize with Authorization: Bearer <token> by leader -> Receive 200 with Team finalized and registrations created (or redirect to payment for paid events)
POST /api/events/:id/teams with Authorization: Bearer <token> using a duplicate teamName -> Receive 400 Validation error 'team name already exists' or unique constraint error

features.name: Payment Integration (Razorpay)
features.description: Create Razorpay orders for paid registrations or finalized teams; verify payments via frontend and webhook to confirm registrations.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid token -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/events/:id/payments with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { registrationId } -> Receive 200 with { orderId, amount, currency } -> Frontend completes Razorpay checkout -> POST /api/events/:id/payments (verify) with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature } -> Receive 200 and registration updated to paymentStatus = completed and status = confirmed

POST /api/events/:id/payments/webhook (Razorpay sends webhook) with invalid signature -> Receive 400 'Signature verification failed' and payment not processed -> Later frontend verify may still succeed or webhook retried

features.name: Coupon & Discount System
features.description: Organizers create coupons; students validate coupons during registration to receive fixed or percentage discounts subject to usage and expiry rules.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with student token -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/events/:id/coupons/validate with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { couponCode } -> Receive 200 with { valid: true, discount: number, discountType: 'percentage'|'fixed' } -> POST /api/events/:id/register with applied coupon -> Receive 201 with registration and discounted amount reflected

POST /api/events/:id/coupons/validate with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { couponCode } when coupon expired or max uses reached -> Receive 400 with message 'Invalid / expired coupon' or 'Maximum usage limit reached'

features.name: QR Code Attendance Scanning
features.description: Volunteers and authorized staff scan participant QR codes to record entry/exit and maintain attendance logs with gate and remarks.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with volunteer (canScanQr=true) -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/events/:id/scan with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { qrCode, scanType: 'ENTRY', gate?: 'Main Entrance', remarks?: 'on time' } -> Receive 200 { success: true, participant: {...}, scanType: 'ENTRY' } -> GET /api/events/:id/registrations with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with updated registration entry status
POST /api/events/:id/scan with Authorization: Bearer <token> by volunteer who has canScanQr=false -> Receive 403 Not authorized to scan

features.name: Certificate System
features.description: Design templates, generate personalized PDF certificates (Puppeteer -> S3) and send to recipients; certificates include persistent verification codes and public verification endpoint.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with organizer token -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/events/:id/certificates/generate with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with { generated: number } and backend starts generation pipeline (Puppeteer => S3) -> GET /api/certificates/verify/:code (public) -> Receive 200 { valid: true, certificate: { verificationCode, holderName, event } }

POST /api/events/:id/certificates/generate with Authorization: Bearer <token> when Puppeteer job fails/timeout -> Receive 200 with { generated: N } but per-recipient logs show failedCount > 0 and individual recipients marked failed in history; GET /api/certificates/verify/:invalidCode -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Bulk Email System
features.description: Organizers compose and send bulk emails (SendGrid) to registrants with credit checks, scheduling, open-tracking pixel and history logging.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with organizer token -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/events/:id/bulk-email with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { subject, body, recipientFilter } where credits available -> Receive 200 { sent: number } and send logs created; GET /api/events/:id/emails/history with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with Email history including sentCount and open analytics
POST /api/events/:id/bulk-email with Authorization: Bearer <token> when email credits insufficient -> Receive 400 'Insufficient email credits' and no emails are sent

features.name: Stall Management
features.description: Organizers create stalls and review student stall applications; students can apply for stall opportunities per event.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with organizer token -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/events/:id/stalls with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { stallName, description } -> Receive 201 with Stall -> GET /api/events/:id/stalls (no auth) -> Receive 200 with Stall[] including newly created stall
POST /api/events/:id/stalls/:stallId/apply with Authorization: Bearer <student token> when application portal closed -> Receive 400 or 403 'Application portal closed' and application not created

features.name: Feedback System
features.description: Public feedback for events and stalls (no auth) with multi-criterion rating (1-10) and optional text; aggregated results available to creators.
user_flows: POST /api/events/:id/feedback (no auth) with body { rating, comment } -> Receive 201 Feedback -> GET /api/events/:id/feedback with organizer token -> Receive 200 aggregated feedback and list of responses
POST /api/events/:id/feedback (no auth) with invalid payload (missing rating) -> Receive 400 Validation error 'rating required'

features.name: Event Management Dashboard (Registrations & Analytics)
features.description: Organizers manage event via dashboard tabs: Overview, Registrations, Volunteers, Stalls, Feedback and Analytics with protected endpoints for registration lists and analytics.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with event creator token -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/events/:id/registrations with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with Registration[] and filter options -> GET /api/events/:id/analytics with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with { totalRegistrations, attendanceRate, registrationsByDate }
GET /api/events/:id/registrations with student token (not creator) -> Receive 403 Forbidden when user lacks event_manage_own/all permission

tech_stack.other: Razorpay (payments), SendGrid (email), Puppeteer + AWS S3 (certificates), JWT (auth), React Query, Zustand, Tailwind CSS
